target_customer: Software developers and small teams who want to pair-program in their own native editors
problem: Remote pair programming and code collaboration forced developers into web-based editors rather than their own tools.
business_model: Freemium SaaS, paid private workspaces from $15 per month

competitors.name: Cloud9
competitors.traction_then: Named by TechCrunch as an alternative using web editors

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time sync across many editors via plugins needs operational-transform style merging and a plugin per editor, a moderate job for two engineers.

defensibility.rationale: Editor plugins were useful but replicable; web IDEs and later editor-native features competed for the same need.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source documents what competitors or editors did; later products such as editor-native live sharing are not sourced here.

market_need_then: Remote work and pair programming interest around 2013; the team had been working on the idea since August 2012 and published an update 10 months in.

branding.domain_note: floobits.com now hosts an unrelated French e-commerce directory (checked Nov 2026), so the original domain was lost or sold.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer-casual; GitHub org tagline Work together, apart.

brand_strength.rationale: Playful coinage known mostly among developers; no evidence about brand effects.

outcome_analysis: Floobits launched in July 2013 with two founders and no outside funding beyond YC, offering native-editor collaboration plugins. The directory marks it Inactive, but no shutdown announcement, post-mortem or acquirer was found, so the cause and date are not public. GitHub repositories show maintenance activity through December 2022, suggesting a long low-intensity life rather than an early collapse.
notes: Directory status Inactive; no source states a shutdown, so exit type is unknown rather than shutdown. Outcome search (two queries) found nothing. Seed amounts not found; TechCrunch (July 2013) said no outside funding beyond YC. Name origin not found. Last GitHub repo updates seen: Dec 2022.
